headline: No temp break anywhere — neither day is a bluefin day
body:
Safety first: the Oxnard synopsis calls for widespread Small Craft Advisory winds and hazardous seas Saturday into Sunday, with Tropical Storm Rachel 850 NM southwest and tracking northeast. Today is the soft day — light morning winds in the east channel going W 10 to 15 kt this afternoon, 2 to 3 ft inside, about 4 ft out in the triangle with 7 kn at midday. Saturday starts quiet inside but the outer grounds go first: 20 kn NW at dawn over Santa Rosa Flats, 15 to 20 kt gusting 25 and seas building 7 to 9 ft out there by afternoon, and 12 kn WNW in the triangle by 3 pm.

The bluefin call is the easy part, and it's no. The triangle corners read 73.2 west, 74.0 east, 73.5 at the south point — every number five-plus degrees warm of the red 68 isotherm, so the break is not inside the zone. It hasn't slid to the other grounds either: Osborn 73.9, San Nicolas 73.3, and Santa Rosa Flats coolest at 71.0 today, 70.2 tomorrow — still outside the band, and the worst ride of the four. Save the fuel.
